quote: We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的输入序列邻域，这会把最大路径长度增至 O(n/r)，作者表示计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.
claim: 作者提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制建立输入与输出的全局依赖，摒弃循环与卷积 [S1.p4]。

quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.
claim: 主流序列转换模型基于复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，包含编码器和解码器，性能最好的模型还通过注意力机制连接编码器与解码器 [abstract]。

quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
claim: 论文在两个机器翻译任务上进行实验，即 WMT 2014 英德和英法翻译任务 [abstract]。

quote: We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property.
claim: Transformer 以三种方式使用多头注意力：编码器-解码器注意力、编码器自注意力，以及带掩码以保持自回归性质的解码器自注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并将模型迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets 和 Oxford Flowers-102 等基准 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: In order to perform classification, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable “classification token” to the sequence.
claim: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，然后把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，然后把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 本文受 Transformer 在 NLP 中扩展成功的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像 [S1.p3]。

quote: Vision Transformer models pre-trained on the JFT-300M dataset outperform ResNet-based baselines on all datasets, while taking substantially less computational resources to pre-train.
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT 在所有数据集上优于基于 ResNet 的基线，且预训练所需计算资源大幅更少 [S4.T2]。

quote: Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
claim: 预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但其访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务特定架构，且提供决策来源和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但其访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务特定架构，且提供决策来源和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 已有结合掩码语言模型与可微检索器的混合模型（REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答 [S1.p1]。

quote: We marginalize the latent documents with a top-K approximation, either on a per-output basis (assuming the same document is responsible for all tokens) or a per-token basis (where different documents are responsible for different tokens).
claim: RAG 通过通用微调方法为预训练参数记忆生成模型赋予非参数记忆：参数记忆是预训练 seq2seq transformer（BART），非参数记忆是 Wikipedia 的稠密向量索引，由预训练神经检索器（DPR）访问 [S1.p2]。

quote: Like T5 or BART, RAG can be fine-tuned on any seq2seq task, whereby both the generator and retriever are jointly learned.
claim: RAG 通过通用微调方法为预训练参数记忆生成模型赋予非参数记忆：参数记忆是预训练 seq2seq transformer（BART），非参数记忆是 Wikipedia 的稠密向量索引，由预训练神经检索器（DPR）访问 [S1.p2]。

quote: Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101.
claim: 此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 目标检测任务上，采用 Faster R-CNN，将 VGG-16 替换为 ResNet-101 进行验证 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error
claim: 与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance, and the leading results on the challenging ImageNet dataset all exploit “very deep” models, with a depth of sixteen to thirty.
claim: 其动机在于网络深度对图像分类至关重要，领先的 ImageNet 结果都使用了十六到三十层的极深模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 更好（提升 2.8%），且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256.
claim: 在 ImageNet 实现中，采用批归一化、SGD（mini-batch 256，学习率从 0.1 开始，误差平台时除以 10，训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代，权重衰减 0.0001，动量 0.9），不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions
claim: 在 token 效率方面，对简单问题仍存在过度推理（overthinking）现象 [S6.p4]。

quote: the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models
claim: DeepSeek-R1 的结构化输出能力仍不如现有模型，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具提升输出性能 [S6.p3]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思性推理和系统性探索替代方案等高级策略，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: Compared to Dev2, DeepSeek-R1 Dev3 achieves notable performance improvements on AlpacaEval 2.0 and Aider-Polyglot
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，论文在多个基准上比较了不同开发阶段的性能，包括 IF-Eval、ArenaHard、AIME、AlpacaEval 2.0 和 Aider-Polyglot 等 [S4.p2][S4.p3]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段学习框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调 [S1.p3]。

quote: from 50% to 57% on AIME24.
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: Budget forcing leads to the best scaling as it has perfect controllability with a clear positive slope leading to strong performance.
claim: 数据选择方面，联合纳入难度、多样性、质量很重要，且 budget forcing 因具有完美可控性和清晰正斜率而带来最佳扩展 [S1.p3]。

quote: We benchmark s1-32B on reasoning-intensive tasks and vary test-time compute.
claim: 作者在推理密集型任务上对 s1-32B 进行基准测试，并变化测试时算力 [S1.F1]。

quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在众多 o1 复现尝试中，尚无人公开复现出清晰的测试时扩展行为，因此作者追问实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: If the model generates more thinking tokens than a desired limit, we forcefully end the thinking process by appending an end-of-thinking token delimiter.
claim: 作者构建了 s1K 数据集，包含 1,000 个精心挑选的问题及其从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏出的推理轨迹和答案，并在现成预训练模型上进行监督微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME24 and 95.6% on MATH500, surpassing previous fine-tuned models (6.5% on AIME24, 59.2% on MATH500)
claim: LIMO 在 AIME24 上达到 63.3%、MATH500 上达到 95.6%，超过此前微调模型（AIME24 6.5%、MATH500 59.2%），且仅使用其 1% 的训练数据 [abstract]。

quote: OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
claim: 作者将 LIMO 与先前微调模型比较，并对比了更大规模数据集 NuminaMath-100k 和 OpenThoughts-114k [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME24 and 95.6% on MATH500
claim: 实验在数学推理基准上进行，包括 AIME24 和 MATH500 [abstract]。

quote: first conducting coarse difficulty filtering to eliminate trivial problems, then fine-grained difficulty assessment to identify challenging questions, followed by knowledge point diversification
claim: 基于此，作者设计多层数据筛选流程，从大量问答对中先做粗粒度难度过滤、再做细粒度难度评估和知识点多样化，同时按逻辑连贯性、步骤清晰度和解答正确性筛选推理链，最终得到 800 条训练样本 [S1.p4]。

quote: sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes
claim: 作者提出 LIMO 假说：在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理能力可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程演示而涌现 [S3.p1]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例 [S4.p1]。

quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的智能体，可与计算机交互解决具有挑战性的真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。

quote: We show that ACIs tailored specifically for LMs outperform existing user interfaces (UIs) designed for human users, such as the Linux shell.
claim: 本文要解决的问题是：界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的性能，以及如何为 LM 智能体设计专门的计算机接口以完成软件工程任务 [abstract][S1.p3]。

quote: SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例 [S4.p1]。

quote: we posit that LM agents represent a new category of end users with their own needs and abilities, and would benefit from specially-built interfaces to the software they use.
claim: 本文要解决的问题是：界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的性能，以及如何为 LM 智能体设计专门的计算机接口以完成软件工程任务 [abstract][S1.p3]。

quote: Note that each chain-of-thought solution is sampled with temperature 0.7.
claim: 此外还研究了在零样本思维链提示下使用内部理由的效果，在 128 个 GSM8K 测试样本上以温度 0.7 采样 8 条链并取多数投票 [S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
claim: 作者指出，为解决各种元学习挑战而做了一些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术从零开始训练模型时是否有效，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。

quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
claim: 实验评估模型在 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 上的零样本直接推理能力，并考察思考 token 数量对性能的影响 [S5.p1][S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：STaR 等方法依赖人工整理的问答数据集来学习推理，这限制了理由的规模和泛化性，因为高质量问答数据集只能覆盖推理任务的一个子集 [S1.p2]。

quote: there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
claim: 此外，无法确知模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

quote: Interestingly, the relationship between coverage and the number of samples is often log-linear and can be modelled with an exponentiated power law, suggesting the existence of inference-time scaling laws.
claim: 覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级范围内扩展，且覆盖率与样本数的关系常呈对数线性，可用指数幂律建模 [abstract]。

quote: This leads to a growing gap between the performance achieved with these methods and the coverage upper bound.
claim: 在没有自动验证器的领域，多数投票和奖励模型等常见选择方法在约 100 样本后趋于平台期，与覆盖率上界之间的差距不断扩大 [S1.p12]。

quote: With repeated sampling, we consider a setup where a model can generate many candidate solutions while attempting to solve a problem.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：在 pass-fail 任务上，让模型为每个问题生成多个候选解，关注的成功率同时受覆盖率（能否生成正确样本）和精度（能否识别正确样本）影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: We present our re-scaled results for MiniF2F, CodeContests, MATH, and GSM8K in Figure 4.
claim: 作者还在固定 FLOP 预算下比较不同模型与样本数的覆盖率，并比较 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct、GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 3.5 在 SWE-bench Lite 上的 API 价格 [S1.p9][S2.SS3.p4]。

quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.
claim: 论文关注的问题是：在推理阶段，用户和开发者通常限制模型只做一次尝试，而训练计算扩展已带来显著能力提升，因此本文探索将推理计算作为另一个扩展轴，通过重复采样来提升推理性能 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
claim: 同时，GPT-3 在 ANLI、RACE、QuAC 等任务上仍表现不佳 [S1.p13]。

quote: In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks and tasks that are similar to language modeling, such as Cloze tasks and sentence/paragraph completion tasks.
claim: 论文在超过二十个 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应能力而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，所有任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置下进行 [S1.p9][S3.p3]。

quote: it may eventually run into (or could already be running into) the limits of the pretraining objective
claim: 更根本地，扩大任何类语言模型可能最终触及预训练目标的极限，因为当前目标对每个 token 等权、缺乏重要性概念，且模型未扎根于视频或物理交互等其他经验领域 [S5.p4]。

quote: This could be a possible explanation for GPT-3’s lagging few-shot performance on a few of the tasks, such as WIC
claim: 结构上，实验仅使用自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能牺牲了在受益于双向性的任务上的性能，例如 WIC、ANLI 和若干阅读理解任务 [S5.p3]。

quote: For LAMBADA and Storycloze there is no supervised training set available so we draw conditioning examples from the development set and evaluate on the test set.
claim: 少样本评估时，从该任务的训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，LAMBADA 和 Storycloze 因无监督训练集而从开发集抽取 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: The results show that Llama 3 8B outperforms competing models in virtually every category, both in terms of per-category win rate and in terms of average per-category performance.
claim: Llama 3 8B 在几乎所有类别上优于竞争模型，70B 在多数基准上大幅优于 Llama 2 70B，并优于 Mixtral 8x22B [S5.SS1.SSS1.p4]。

quote: our flagship language model was pre-trained using $3.8\times 10^{25}$ FLOPs
claim: 预训练使用约 15T 多语言 token，旗舰模型为 405B 参数、3.8×10^25 FLOPs [S1.p5]。

quote: Using the resulting Llama 3-V 405B model, we outperform GPT-4V on all benchmarks, while being slightly behind Gemini 1.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
claim: 多模态方面，Llama 3-V 405B 在所有图像识别基准上优于 GPT-4V，但略落后于 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet [S7.SS6.p2]；语音接口在语音识别基准上优于 Whisper 和 SeamlessM4T [S8.SS4.p3]。

quote: We hope that the open release of a flagship model will spur a wave of innovation in the research community, and accelerate a responsible path towards the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
claim: 作者希望公开旗舰模型的发布能推动研究社区创新，并加速负责任地迈向通用人工智能的发展 [S1.p7]。

quote: The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
claim: 本文旨在提出并公开一套新的语言基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: we selected several representative benchmarks to assess the model’s capabilities across a variety of domains, including general tasks, mathematics and science tasks, coding tasks, and alignment task.
claim: 评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学任务、纯文本任务、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解以及 GUI Agent 等基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: on composite OCR-related understanding benchmarks as OCRBench, InfoVQA which focusing on infographics, and SEED-Bench-2-Plus covering text-rich scenarios including charts, maps, and webs
claim: 评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学任务、纯文本任务、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解以及 GUI Agent 等基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Structurally, we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 由视觉编码器和语言模型解码器组成，视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: on the MMStar dataset, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 63.9%, while Qwen2.5-VL-3B scores 55.9%.
claim: 较小的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 3B 也表现有竞争力，例如 MMStar 上分别为 63.9% 和 55.9% [S3.SS3.SSS1.p4]。

quote: We introduce dynamic FPS sampling, extending dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension and enabling comprehensive video understanding across varied sampling rates
claim: 模型引入动态 FPS 采样将动态分辨率扩展到时间维度，并升级 MRoPE 在时间域对齐绝对时间 [S1.p4]。

quote: Overall, the benchmark validation set has 64 videos, whereas the test set has 128 videos.
claim: 在视频编辑方面，作者在 TGVE+ 和自建的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评估，后者包含 64 个验证视频和 128 个测试视频，视频具有不同分辨率、FPS、长度和宽高比 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS3.SSS1.p3]。

quote: we introduce a multi-stage approach that progressively minimizes these discrepancies
claim: 此外，作者通过后训练为模型加入个性化能力，并采用多阶段方法训练视频编辑模型 [S2.p3][S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
claim: 在音频生成方面，作者使用 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 以及自建的 Movie Gen Audio Bench（527 个视频）等数据集进行评估 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。

quote: On the TGVE+ benchmark, our model is preferred 74% more often than the current state-of-the-art EVE in the overall Human evaluation criterion.
claim: 在视频编辑上，人类评估者在 TGVE+ 基准上偏好 Movie Gen Edit 超过此前最优方法 EVE 达 74% [S5.SS3.SSS1.p4]。

quote: While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
